title: Two neighborhoods
summary: Keep more than 5 Sprinters in the fresh pool and more than 5 Brinecoils in the brine pool, both at once, for 180 seconds of dish time. Falling below starts the count again.
completedText: Both neighborhoods held more than 5 for 180 seconds, measured in this attempt at {time}.
endedText: No Sprinters or no Brinecoils remain anywhere in the dish, so this attempt ended at {time}. The dish keeps going.
